reasons.plausibility: Dispersion-strengthening via rare-earth oxides is well-established in similar alloys, though there are some challenges in ensuring uniform oxide distribution in refractory HEAs.
reasons.testability: A direct comparison of doped and undoped samples under identical high-temperature and irradiation conditions provides a clear route to falsification.
reasons.usefulness: It addresses a key challenge in refractory HEA design—balancing high-temperature mechanical properties with irradiation tolerance—making it highly relevant and actionable.
